places.name: Top of the Rock
places.description: Observation deck at the 70th floor of 30 Rockefeller Plaza. Unobstructed Empire State Building view to the south; Central Park to the north. Open-air upper deck at 260m.
highlights: Empire State Building framed in open-air

places.name: Central Park
places.description: 840 acres of designed landscape by Olmsted & Vaux (1857). Bethesda Fountain, The Reservoir, Great Lawn, Bow Bridge. More than 40 million visitors per year.
highlights: Bow Bridge — New York's most photographed

places.name: Eataly Flatiron
places.description: Massive Italian marketplace across two floors: fresh pasta counter, fish bar, Nutella café, pizza al taglio, gelato. Best prosecco bar in New York on the roof.
highlights: Fresh pasta made on site, 20 cuts

places.name: The High Line
places.description: 2.4km elevated linear park on a disused 1930s freight rail. Hudson Yards on one end, Gansevoort on the other. Public art, food vendors, deck chairs over 10th Avenue.
highlights: 10th Avenue Square — traffic overhead glass floor
Commissioned public art along the route

places.name: The Vessel — Hudson Yards
places.description: Thomas Heatherwick's copper lattice structure of 154 interconnecting staircases at Hudson Yards. 16 stories of climbable steps and 80 landings. A public artwork you can inhabit.
highlights: Views of Hudson River and Chelsea

places.name: Brooklyn Bridge
places.description: Gothic revival suspension bridge completed 1883, first steel-wire bridge in the world. Wooden pedestrian walkway provides iconic Dumbo and Downtown Manhattan views.
highlights: Wooden upper promenade — biking or walking
View Downtown Manhattan skyline from Dumbo

places.name: MoMA
places.description: Museum of Modern Art: Monet's Water Lilies, Picasso's Les Demoiselles d'Avignon, Warhol's Campbell's Soup Cans, Cindy Sherman. 200,000 works spanning 1880 to today.

places.name: Smorgasburg Brooklyn
places.description: America's largest weekly open-air food market: 100 vendors every Saturday in Williamsburg Waterfront. Ramen burgers, Halal Guys, Jamaican jerk, ice cream sandwiches.
